title: Earthily Roasted Australian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty one-pot Australian dish featuring roasted lamb and raw vegetables in a rich braise, gluten-free friendly. This stew is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then remove from the pot.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, cooking for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the tomato paste to the pot, stirring to combine, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, thyme, and rosemary to the pot, stirring to combine, and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew in the oven for 2.5 hours, until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
